roleHelp.OWNER: Everything, including the organization's name, address, admins and deletion.
roleHelp.ADMIN: Creates and removes members and manages every board.
roleHelp.MEMBER: Creates boards and works on the boards shared with the organization.

dashboard.sharedText: Boards of other workspaces where someone added you.

createOrg.intro: A free space for your company or team: create your employees' accounts and share boards with all of them.
createOrg.name: Organization name
createOrg.slugHint: Your boards will be at /{slug}/board-name. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

page.guest: You see the boards someone shared with you.
page.suspendedText: Its boards cannot be opened until the administrator of the service lifts the suspension. Reason: {reason}
page.empty: No boards yet. Create the first one above.
page.twoFactorRequired: This organization requires two-step verification. Turn it on to open its boards.

members.title: Members
members.leaveHint: You will lose access to its boards. You can be added again later.
members.createText: The account belongs to the person; this organization can reset its password or remove it. Give them the email and password you set: they can change the password in their settings.
members.name: Name
members.created: Account created. Give the person their email and initial password.
members.passwordReset: Password changed. Their open sessions and API tokens were closed.
members.invited: Account created. We emailed {email} a link to choose their password (valid for 7 days).
members.inviteFailed: The account was created, but the invitation email could not be sent. Set an initial password for them below and hand it over.
members.createTextInvite: We email the person a link to choose their own password. The account belongs to the person; this organization can reset its password or remove it.
members.subtitle: The people of {name} and what each one can do.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.name: Name
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owners can change the name, the address or delete the organization.
settings.deleteText: Deletes the organization with all its boards, lists, cards and attachments. Employee accounts stay, without the organization. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmMismatch: Type the organization's address exactly to confirm.
settings.indexText: Everything about {name}, one page per section. Your role: {role}.

visibility.label: Who can see it
visibility.PRIVATE: Only its members and the organization's admins

hints.general: Name, address, leaving and the danger zone
hints.members: Who is in the organization and their role
hints.roles: What each role can do, and your own roles
hints.teams: Groups of people that share access to boards
hints.security: Two-step verification, email domains and sessions

general.title: General
general.subtitle: The organization's brand, name and address, and leaving it. Owners change the name and the address; owners and admins the brand.
general.addressHint: If you change the address, old links to its boards stop working (links with a board's id keep working).

deleteBoards.one: Deletes its {count} board with its lists, cards and attachments. Employee accounts stay, without the organization. This cannot be undone.
deleteBoards.other: Deletes its {count} boards with their lists, cards and attachments. Employee accounts stay, without the organization. This cannot be undone.

handle.label: Your address
handle.hint: Your personal boards live here. If you change it, old links with the previous address stop working.

rolesPage.title: Roles and permissions
rolesPage.subtitle: The three base roles cannot be changed. Create your own to give someone exactly the permissions they need.
rolesPage.locked: Base roles cannot be edited or deleted.
rolesPage.readOnly: Only owners and admins edit roles.
rolesPage.holdersNone: Nobody has it yet: give it from Members.
rolesPage.name: Name
rolesPage.baseOnly: Owners and admins only. It cannot be given to a custom role.
rolesPage.newHint: Name the role and choose what it can do.
rolesPage.deleteConfirm: The people who have it become plain members. This cannot be undone.
rolesPage.rule: Nobody can create or edit a role with permissions they do not hold, and a custom role can never change roles or delete the organization.

boards.view_all.label: See every board of the organization
boards.view_all.hint: Private ones too, read-only, without being invited.

boards.visibility.label: Change who sees a board
boards.visibility.hint: Switch any board it can open between the whole organization and private.

boards.delete.label: Delete boards
boards.delete.hint: Any board of the organization it can open.

people.remove.label: Remove people from the organization
people.remove.hint: Plain members only, never admins or owners.

backups.manage.label: Manage backups
backups.manage.hint: Schedule them, change where they go and restore.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Give a group of people access to several boards at once. Someone in a team keeps the highest permission among everything that gives them access.
teams.name: Name
teams.noBoards: This team gives access to no board yet.
teams.rule: If someone reaches a board by several paths (their role, a team or a direct invitation) they keep the highest permission. A team never gives more than the person setting it up has.
teams.readOnly: Only people allowed to manage teams change them.
teams.deleteText: Its people stay in the organization; they lose the access the team gave them.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.subtitle: Everything important that happened in the organization: people, roles, boards, integrations, data and security.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Who can get in and from where. Only owners and admins see this page.
security.blockedNow: They cannot open the organization's boards until they turn it on.
security.require2faHint: Nobody without it opens the organization's boards (guests included). You need it on yourself to turn this on.
security.domainsHint: One per line. New employee accounts and board invitations must use one of them. Empty: any.
security.sessionsTitle: Sessions of the accounts you created
security.sessionsHint: Only accounts this organization created: the devices of people who signed up on their own are their business.
security.noManaged: This organization has not created any account yet.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: How the organization looks in orgtable: its logo, its colour and its time zone.
brand.timezoneHint: Scheduled backups run at night in this time zone.
brand.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 512 KB. Square looks best.
brand.ownerOnlyName: Only owners change the name and the address.
